findings.title: Sharded queries are interpolated twice
findings.body: runSplitQuery now maps every target through datasource.applyTemplateVariables. runShardSplitQuery already interpolates the same targets at public/app/plugins/datasource/loki/shardQuerySplitting.ts:52 before calling runSplitQuery for each shard group at public/app/plugins/datasource/loki/shardQuerySplitting.ts:163. As a result, targets can be passed through applyTemplateVariables multiple times. Template replacement and ad-hoc filter injection are not guaranteed to be idempotent: filters may be appended twice and variable values containing '$' may be expanded again, producing incorrect or invalid LogQL. Consider adding an option to skip interpolation for already-interpolated subrequests or centralizing interpolation in one place.

findings.title: Queries that interpolate to an empty expression are no longer removed
findings.body: runShardSplitQuery filters query.expr before calling applyTemplateVariables, while the previous code interpolated first and then filtered empty expressions. If a query expression is a variable that resolves to an empty string, the target now survives interpolation with an empty expr and is passed into sharding/splitting. This can cause empty stream selectors, invalid shard queries, or unnecessary label-value lookups. runSplitQuery has the same ordering issue at public/app/plugins/datasource/loki/querySplitting.ts:298; filter again after interpolation.
